ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image shows a virtual island, with sea-area depth contours around the island, and the legend also marks “fishing ports that may be developed,” with locations such as Jia, Yi, Bing, and Ding, indicating that the background of the question is coastal fishing ports of an island and marine fishery development. The question asks about “fish product processing factories are often found near fishing ports.” Fishing ports are places where fish catches are landed and distributed, and the processing objects of fish product processing factories are precisely fish catches. Processing factories being close to fishing ports can obtain fish raw materials nearby and reduce transport losses of perishable raw materials. Therefore, the industrial location factor mainly considered is raw materials.
